newsitem.title: USA: Rubin says Greenspan supportive of new bond.
newsitem.headline: Rubin says Greenspan supportive of new bond.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan is supportive of a new inflation-linked Treasury bond.

Rubin, talking to reporters on President Clinton's flight from Washington to Pittsburgh to announce the new bond, said the U.S. government decided to go ahead with the bond in May but it took until now to work out the details.
"I think this is going to be very big. I think it's a better way for people to save," he said.

He said the strongest argument within government circles against the plan was that it would lower resistance against inflation, but it was decided that that fear was groundless. He described Greenspan as "supportive."
